summary: Continue active Bonk & Bolt stewardship toward the full 3D cartoon open-world RPG vision; this bounded presentation pass does not complete the lifetime objective.
The sole write lane remained game-library/014-bonk-and-bolt. Foreign activity in slots 012, 013, 015, 016, 017 and 018 was observed and not edited; no shared registry was touched.

Blender and production skeletal assets remained unavailable, so the selected bounded seam built an engine-independent motion contract and versioned semantic rig binding over the existing local primitives.
The slice preserved no-pressure economics, exact challenge wording, local shared-screen co-op, robot-world roles, existing combat timing and damage, no junk rewards and separate-game ownership.
runtime/motion-system.js now deterministically samples attack, special and dodge phases for all three classes without depending on Three.js, making the same source directly Node-testable.
Panzer owns a heavy pan slam, Pun-Slinger owns bread recoil and fan motion, and Gear Shepherd owns a conductor command sweep; action colors and silhouettes remain distinct.

Every hero now exposes version-1 root, body, head, left arm, right arm, legs, weapon and action-cue bindings so future licensed skeletal rigs can replace procedural parts without changing combat rules.
Reduced motion suppresses locomotion bounce and all action pose travel while retaining a static class-colored action cue; all actions still settle deterministically.
Local player two runs the same independent tested action system. Live slash input placed P2 in impact while player one remained settled, then both returned to settled.

Repeated 1280x720 observations covered Panzer attack, Pun-Slinger special, Gear Shepherd special, independent P2 attack and reduced-motion cue states. Browser warnings and errors were empty and tabs were finalized.
Final verdicts are hero motion PASS 8 of 8, systems PASS 226, package PASS 101, HTTP 4 of 4, focused verifier 0 errors and 0 warnings, browser logs empty and port 8814 clean.
Production skeletal assets and the optional rolling buffer remain unavailable. Exact phase cadence is claimed only from deterministic tests, never screenshots.

The full objective remains active. Continue one bounded high-value seam, preferring provenance-ready production character and attack rigs when available; preserve the version-1 binding and relocatable asset paths.
